commands.name: relay
commands.description: Pass prompts and answers between a planning session and the session that does the work

children: This folder is not linked to a relay channel.
/relay lead <channel> in the planning session, /relay worker [channel] in the session that does the work, /relay send [text], /relay off, /relay alone shows what is pending.

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main

notes: types ./types/index.d.ts declares on $: nothing (no EngineInterface member)

types ./types/index.d.ts declares state: session-relay.link, session-relay.tasks, session-relay.answers, session-relay.offer, session-relay.isAttached, session-relay.presence, session-relay.isActive, session-relay.footer, session-relay.isHubbed

./register.tsx hooks: session.start, classic.SessionStart, session.end, turn.start, turn.complete, prompt.submit, command.run{command=relay}, ui.press{plugin=mod-hub, element=session-relay:open}, ui.render{component=AbovePrompt}, ui.render{component=Pane, requestId=relay}, ui.render{component=SessionMode}

./register.tsx hooks on classic.SessionStart do not run in a plugin a person installs where an organization manages Claude Code: there, these events pass over the plugins you install, and only a plugin the organization lists in managed settings runs them

./register.tsx calls: $.clock.every (via startPolling), $.clock.now, $.command.register, $.command.run (via takeTask), $.env.get (via relayDirectory), $.fs.exists (via existingChannels, readInbox, readJson), $.fs.list (via existingChannels, readInbox), $.fs.read (via readJson), $.fs.write (via writeItem, writePresence), $.hub.set (via publish), $.process.run, $.prompt.submit (via forwardAnswers, takeTask), $.session.id (via claim, pollWorker, writePresence), $.session.messages (via sendLatestBlock), $.session.root, $.state.get, $.state.set, $.store.delete (via leave), $.store.get, $.store.set (via join), $.ui.close (via forwardAnswers, leave, takeTask), $.ui.notify (via announceAnswers), $.ui.open (via openPane), $.ui.resolve, $.ui.toast (via announceAnswers, announceTasks, attachAnswers, runCommand, sendLatestBlock, sendTask, takeTask)

./register.tsx state writes: session-relay.answers, session-relay.footer, session-relay.isActive, session-relay.isAttached, session-relay.isHubbed, session-relay.link, session-relay.offer, session-relay.presence, session-relay.tasks
